title: Transactional Outbox Plan
description: A structured plan for a transactional-outbox implementation so scripts/outbox_pattern_implementation_audit.mjs can check it deterministically against this skill's Quality Gates.

architecture.description: How DB write and broker publish relate. dual-write and publish-first are the hazards the pattern removes and always fail.

outboxWriteInBusinessTransaction.description: True if the outbox INSERT rides the exact same transaction as the business rows.

relayType.description: How outbox rows reach the broker: polling publisher, Debezium CDC, or none (fails for outbox-relay).

relayInstances.description: How many relay instances run concurrently (raises SKIP LOCKED severity when > 1).

usesSkipLocked.description: True if the polling relay claims rows with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.

partialUnpublishedIndex.description: True if a partial index exists on unpublished rows (WHERE published_at IS NULL).

replicationSlotLagMonitored.description: True if pg_replication_slots lag is monitored/alerted for the CDC relay.

pruneStrategy.description: How published rows are removed. 'none' fails; high volume wants time-partitioning.

consumerIdempotent.description: True if the consumer dedupes -- at-least-once delivery guarantees eventual duplicates.

dedupMechanism.description: The idempotency primitive. Only a DB unique constraint is transactional with the side effect.

schemaHasAggregateType.description: True if the outbox table has aggregate_type (routes to topic).

schemaHasAggregateId.description: True if the outbox table has aggregate_id (Kafka message key / partition ordering).

schemaHasEventType.description: True if the outbox table has event_type.

schemaHasPayload.description: True if the outbox table has a payload column (JSONB).

expectedVolume.description: Expected event volume; 'high' tightens the prune-strategy check.

traceIdInOutboxRow.description: True if trace_id travels in the outbox row for cross-boundary tracing.

lagMetricsExported.description: True if outbox_unpublished_count / oldest-unpublished-age metrics are exported and alerted.
